sections.title: Enemy Overview
sections.content:
Nevrons of the Continent

Expedition 33 features close to 50 different Nevron types throughout the world, plus numerous boss encounters. Each Nevron has unique weaknesses, attack patterns, and drops.

sections.title: Combat Tips Against Enemies
sections.content:
Weaknesses System

Each enemy has elemental weaknesses. Use Lune's Elemental Stains to exploit them for massive bonus damage. Check the enemy info panel (visible during combat) for weakness indicators.

Shield Breaking

  • Boucheclier and other shielded enemies require shield removal first
  • Gun bullets remove 1 shield each
  • Burn status removes 1 shield per turn
  • Multi-hit skills (Gustave's Lumiere Assault) excel at shield breaking

General Strategies

  • Always parry — +1 AP and counter damage make every fight easier
  • Chromatic Nevrons are tough but drop rare Pictos and weapons
  • Petanks require chasing to their ground symbol before fighting
  • Farm at Expedition Flags (resting respawns enemies)

sections.title: Best Farming Spots
sections.content:
• Early game: Festival Shore (Mimes drop tokens)
  • Mid game: Gestral Village area (good XP density)
  • Late game: Endless Tower (best drops, hardest enemies)
  • Chromatic Nevrons: Scattered across the world — always worth fighting for rare rewards
